From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Turner <samuel.turner@cartbridge.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T16:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: hosted eligibility checklist & sandbox runbook

Hi Sam — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap + next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways from our call:
- CartBridge prefers a fast time-to-market pilot; initial appetite is for Hosted API (no infra lift) with the option to revisit Dedicated in Q2 if throughput grows.
- Primary workload: chat and short-form generation for order assistant (~60 tokens per turn average), plus an embeddings batch job nightly.
- Security: standard SOC2 evidence sufficient for the pilot; VPC/on-prem may be required later for PCI scope.

Immediate asks / items we can action this week:
1) Confirm expected concurrency & hourly token volume (a short number suffices: e.g., 20 rps / 5M tokens/day).
2) Which endpoints you want exposed in the sandbox (chat, generate, embeddings, rerank).
3) Any internal IP allowlist or SSO requirements for access.

What I'll provide by EOD:
- A sandbox runbook (attached) with step-by-step onboarding, default endpoint mapping, and how we enforce rate caps.
- An endpoint mapping CSV with suggested prefixes for dev/staging/prod.
- A ratecap matrix with suggested safe limits for the pilot and guidance on burst/bucket sizing.

Quick notes on rate limits and behavior you asked about: 
- Hosted sandbox defaults: per-endpoint soft rate caps (examples in the matrix) and token-based throttling. For your chat flows we typically recommend starting at 40–60 RPS for the dev slice with token caps at 250K tokens/minute overall for the sandbox.
- Prefix/KV caching: we can enable prefix caching to reduce token cost for repeated prompts (helpful for FAQ/order lookup).
- Observability: we’ll give route-level latency/cost metrics and an artifacts link to the trial dashboard.

Next meeting: I can coordinate a 30m ops-preflight with Ben (sales) and Karthik (solutions) to lock the sandbox mapping and get credentials provisioned. Are you available Wed 9/1 10am PT?

Thanks — looking forward.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sandbox_runbook.pdf (PDF, 4 pages); endpoint_mapping.csv (CSV, 1 sheet); ratecap_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 3 sheets)
From: Samuel Turner <samuel.turner@cartbridge.com>

Thanks Soojin — this is great, and yes hosted sounds like the right fit for the pilot. Quick answers: 
- Expected steady-state: ~15–25 RPS for chat during peak, spiking to ~50 RPS for short bursts. Nightly embeddings job will process ~500k small documents (embedding size ~768).
- Endpoints: chat, embeddings, and a smaller generate route for summaries. Rerank not needed for pilot.
- No SSO for initial sandbox; IP allowlist for our staging CIDR would be helpful.

We’re fine with the suggested caps you mentioned — please set the dev sandbox to a conservative default and we can iterate.

Wed 9/1 10am PT works for me. Can you include a short agenda?

Sam
Samuel Turner
Product Lead, CartBridge
samuel.turner@cartbridge.com

Thanks Sam — adding Ben (Account Exec) and Karthik (Solutions) to lock down provisioning and rate policy. Agenda for Wed 9/1 10am PT (30m):

1) Quick pilot scope (5m): confirm endpoints and KV/prefix caching expectations.
2) Sandbox mapping & access (10m): which slices (dev/staging) and credentials flow; IP allowlist step.
3) Ratecaps & observability (10m): start limits, burst allowances, and where to view metrics.
4) Next actions (5m): timeline for handed-off tickets and who owns production evaluation.

Sandbox defaults we’ll provision before the call (details attached and summarized below):
- dev slice: 40 RPS total across chat/generate, 150k tokens/minute cap. Ideal for early functional testing.
- staging slice: 10 RPS, mirroring smaller cadence for integration tests.
- embeddings job: we’ll give a dedicated overnight slot with a token pool of 1M tokens to accommodate the 500k documents; if you need faster throughput we can allocate a burst window.

Endpoint mapping (excerpt):
- /v1/chat -> dev.chat.cartbridge.redwood (dev slice)
- /v1/generate -> dev.gen.cartbridge.redwood
- /v1/embeddings -> batch-embeds.cartbridge.redwood (scheduled night run)

Ratecap notes: the attached ratecap_matrix.xlsx includes soft vs hard caps and recommended escalation path. If you anticipate sustained >200k tokens/day we should start discussions about a Dedicated pool to keep unit costs predictable.

I’ve attached the runbook, endpoint CSV, and matrix. Ben — can you prepare the onboarding link + temporary keys so we can provision before Wed? Karthik — can you flag any model/quantization recommendations during the call if we need to optimize cost?

— Soojin
